On valid handoff retain exact bytes only transiently, no new raw wrapper output. Sidecar IO refusal likewise never converts to carrier success or escapes observe.
TXWrapperHandoff.carrierOnlyHookError: If no legacy output was requested, failure of the NEW carrier-only serialization/return is caught in that new branch; return void and fixed carrier unavailable state. It must not throw out of observe or prevent genuine assertions. Never catch an original legacy error with this new branch.

Safe attempt failure retained when writable; absent sidecar remains an explicit failing validation observation. Return unchanged genuine observed; caller product assertions proceed. Later exact evidence validation rejects missing/invalid carrier independently. Cleanup failure is sticky, original genuine result preserved. Ownership remains unverified.

If legacy output OR carrierPath: ONE JSON.stringify(wrapper,null,2)+newline, ONE UTF8 encoding. Legacy file uses these exact bytes; carrier receives these same bytes/digest. Neither path: original void/no new work. Carrier-only: same in-memory wrapper, no legacy path/readback dependency.
